title: Reducing Dishes
goal: Maximize the sum of cooking completion time times satisfaction.
strategy: Process candidate dishes from greatest satisfaction downward. Prepending one dish increases every selected completion time, giving a net gain equal to the new selected sum.

phasePurposes.start: Maximize the sum of cooking completion time times satisfaction.

phasePurposes.done: Maximize the sum of cooking completion time times satisfaction.

edgeCases: All negative dishes should be skipped
All positive dishes can be included
A zero-satisfaction dish can improve later timing
